★ Request
Running with a serious expression while calmly observing surrounding situation
————Yaaahhhhhhhhh!!

...!
To keep striving... you'll watch me...—

...Ever since I was little, I've always thought: If I keep going like this,
I'll just be a hazy, forgettable "side character" whom nobody remembers.

Huh, no way!? That doesn't look like pre-debut motivation at all...!
She's going so hard, I thought it was a final fast breeze—

Hehe.
...We're the same.

It was all to prove that Dantsu Flame
is an umamusume capable of becoming the "lead protagonist"—

That wasn't something just anyone could pull off.
It was effort toward becoming the "lead protagonist" that only Dantsu Flame could achieve.
(Faster than I thought! But, not yet!!)

...I was happy. Truly. Even though I'm not a lead protagonist yet...
You looked at me as someone who's striving to become one.

(I've built up everything I possibly could with Trainer for this race...!
I'll definitely win and prove myself...!!)

............Um, Trainer.
At the very end, just one more time... could you give me a little time?

......Trainer.
Our contract... is dissolved now, isn't it?

...Even though you've stayed by my side the whole time
for my training............

*pant*... *pant*... *pant*............
Phew...――All set, I'm ready for the next one!
Please let me scout you, Trainer!

That girl's been totally fired up all morning, it's crazy~.
Does she have an important race or something? Maybe a graded race?

Always showing the best possible result she could achieve with her current strength,
proving that step by step, she was steadily moving forward.

If you hadn't been there for today's race, Trainer...
I would've lost terribly... and honestly, I would've been pretty down.
...Then... this time...――

Day after day leading up to the mock race,
Dantsu Flame and I desperately did everything we could.

Trainer...
Why did you... sign a contract with me...?

And... I thought that with you, I could...
aim for my dream more directly... So――

Her outstretched hand, her gentle smile, the flame burning within her.
To me, all of it right now... looked more dazzling than anything else.

But when I won a race... only in that moment...
I felt like a "protagonist" who would stay in everyone's memories...――
Ah, Trainer...――

...Even if we walk separate paths from here on out, I'll have no regrets.
I can truly believe that from the bottom of my heart.

Yes! ...Keep positioning in mind.
Minimize loss around the corners. Minimize loss...! ――Hup!!

............This is delicious, isn't it?
Even when I can't decide what to buy, I always end up getting this in the end.

Agnes Tachyon made the first move.
She's planning to shake off the pack behind her...!

...Dantsu Flame finished in 3rd place.
I couldn't deliver the victory I promised her... Therefore――
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaah............――)

Now I can say it clearly.
What I found in Dantsu Flame. That brilliance.

Taking her hand, I make a vow. To make her the "protagonist,"
and to become a trainer worthy of being a "protagonist" alongside her――
(――――I want to become... the "protagonist"!!!)

...Dantsu Flame stands on the stage,
gazing straight toward me――

The spotlight favorite, Jungle Pocket, is creeping up from behind.
With her late kick, she should be entering striking distance soon.

...As expected, Agnes Tachyon is pacing near the front to read the field.
A flawless run from the start to this point... Truly impressive.

(I want to win...! I want to win, I want to win, I want to win!!
I definitely want to win!! Right now! Absolutely!!)

No, here's what I heard...
Apparently, she hasn't even debuted yet.

Ever since I entered this academy, all along, constantly...
I've kept thinking, "Next time, I want to stand in the center"...――
――Yaaaaaah!!

...For the first time, I stand on the same stage.
Meeting her gaze at eye level, I put it into words.
――...The opening bell rings.
..., Trainer.

...From the days we've spent up until today, I know.
That Dantsu Flame has never once given up, constantly putting in the effort.
Won't you please aim to be the "protagonist" together with me?
The next act... begins from here――

I found the courage.
...Courage to believe that I can still keep aiming to be the "protagonist."
...And finally, the day of the mock race arrived.

A-Amazing...! You really have data on every single runner...!
How did you manage to gather all this...?!

...*pant*, *pant*, *pant*......
Ugh... *sob*...――
